issues.description: The problem statement's UML and the solution expect Stock.take(String) to return an int (returning -1 on failure), but the template's Stock.take is declared to return boolean. This mismatch will cause compilation and behavioral issues when students implement SealSaloon (which relies on Stock.take returning an int) and prevents straightforward implementation of the specified logic.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template's Stock.take method signature and implementation to return an int (matching the UML and solution). The method should return -1 when the ingredient is missing or out of stock, otherwise decrement quantity and return the remaining quantity — matching the behavior shown in the solution and the problem statement.
